title: Task params for oedis.handler.gpg.decrypt
description: Configuration for decrypting OpenPGP-encrypted files from the task inbox using the gpg handler.

private_key.description: Base64-encoded private key. For the GnuPG backend, this should be base64 of the ASCII-armored private key text.

passphrase.description: Optional passphrase used to unlock a protected private key.

requests.description: List of decryption instructions. Each item describes which encrypted inbox files to match and where plaintext files should be written.

src_dir.description: Inbox-relative source directory to read from. Empty or omitted means ctx.inbox. Leading / is treated as inbox-rooted shorthand and the resolved path must stay inside ctx.inbox.

include.description: Encrypted file match pattern or list of patterns to include. Examples: '*.gpg' or ['*.gpg', '*.pgp']. When recursive is true, relative paths under src_dir can also match.

exclude.description: Encrypted file match pattern or list of patterns to exclude after include matching. When recursive is true, relative paths under src_dir can also match.

recursive.description: When true, walk subdirectories under src_dir. When false, only files directly under src_dir are considered.

dst_dir.description: Inbox-relative destination directory for plaintext files. Empty or omitted keeps the handler's default behavior of writing plaintext beside each source file. Leading / is treated as inbox-rooted shorthand and the resolved path must stay inside ctx.inbox.

delete_source_file.description: When true, delete each encrypted source file after it is decrypted successfully.
